theme: Operator Experience — the first of the ratified three-release Beta-1 path (v0.11 Operator Experience -> v0.12 Access & Onboarding -> v1.0 MVP Beta 1). Fixes defects on already-shipped functionality; adds NO new governed capability. E-01: the audit read surface (reverse cursor, newest-first default, server-side actor/outcome/edge filtering, the governed-actions@1 read-time preset, all under the EVD-8 chain-contiguity invariant) closes the v1.0-BLOCKING finding measured live at v0.10.0's WD-10 (635 events, 601 ticker noise, newest entries 13 pages deep). E-07: targeted, panel-scoped, active-only, visibility-paused live detail refresh for the charter panel. E-08: read-side charter-scope memory resolution closes the inversion where the operator saw less than the composer. Zero new capability/edge/actor/grant/token/credential/consent-moment/egress-path/service/unit/env/key/third-party-dependency; zero write path; the only migration is a read-only index (0002).
status: release candidate — GATE-1 (WD-1..10 regression, compose + installed) and GATE-2 (browser smoke) are GREEN; OI-18..20 hold. GATE-3 (the CEO SS human spot-check, scripted by the War Room Commander per verification_runbook.md Step 6) is the remaining gate. This artifact set stays release-candidate until the Phase B closure commit flips it to released and the local annotated tag v0.11.0 lands (no remote, per repo doctrine).

adrs.ADR-0067: Accepted 2026-07-26 — Audit read semantics: the EVD-8 chain-contiguity invariant (D1); reverse cursor + newest-first default + seq-direction-only ordering, narrowing E-01/S-03 from per-column sorters (D2); the lifecycle-noise policy as a versioned read-time preset, governed-actions@1, never write-side suppression/rollup/a stored column (D3); server-side filtering over the whole chain answering (not overriding) the v0.1.0 no-client-side-filtering rule (D4); disclosure via chainHead = MAX(seq), renamed from chainLength for semantic precision (D5); E-07 targeted panel-scoped polling, SSE deferred past the E-06 freeze (D6); E-08 read-side scope resolution, no backfill (D7); the gate = WD-1..10 regression + smoke + a SS human spot-check, no new WD, re-tested not inherited (D8); fragment discipline — new named components only, LimitParam/CursorParam untouched (D9). Extends ADR-0045/0049/0044/0043/0047/0064/0065/0066; preserves ADR-0046 (no edge added, lit, or reserved); edits no Accepted ADR (G2-clean).
